title: Dragon Diner Stasis Pause
description: A surreal fantasy scene inside a cosmic diner where a person in a green hoodie sits at a curved counter with a CRT monitor displaying a game. A red devil-like demon sits on a stool holding a blue drink, while a large golden dragon wearing a party hat and a blue knight stand behind the counter with food items including a purple cake and a sword labeled 'Excalibur'.
prompt: A highly detailed whimsical fantasy scene set in a cosmic space diner with a starry purple nebula sky and lightning in the background. In the foreground a person in a green hoodie sits at a curved white counter with an old CRT monitor showing a pixel game, a scroll with text, and a slice of purple cake. A red devil demon with horns and cape sits on a red and yellow stool holding a glowing blue drink. Behind the counter stands a majestic golden dragon wearing a pink party hat next to a blue armored knight holding a glowing blue sword labeled Excalibur. In the distance a floating island with a circus tent and windmill connected by a stone path with glowing mushrooms, dramatic lighting with green lamp over the counter, fun and surreal atmosphere
